q: How much electricity does a groundnut decorticator unit use per tonne?
title: Groundnut decorticator: power per tonne
short: A decorticating unit shells pods with motors, fans and sieves. Read units from the electricity bill and divide by tonnes of pods shelled, then multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Shells used as boiler fuel elsewhere are biomass, not counted as your emission.
audience: Groundnut shelling units and oil mills

ul: Tonnes of pods and kernels from the stock register.

p: Selling shells as fuel or briquette feedstock is income. The buyer burning them reports biogenic CO2.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
